senses.en: deserving respect or admiration
senses.zh: 值得尊敬的；值得钦佩的

example.en: She has made an estimable contribution to science.
example.zh: 她为科学作出了令人钦佩的贡献。

senses.en: a person who makes or repairs silver objects

example.en: The silversmith crafted a beautiful silver teapot.
example.zh: 银匠打造了一把漂亮的银茶壶。

senses.en: toward the sea

example.en: The ships sailed seaward at dawn.
example.zh: 船只在黎明时向大海驶去。

senses.en: facing or directed toward the sea

example.en: The seaward side of the island is exposed to strong winds.
example.zh: 岛屿朝海的一侧暴露在强风中。

senses.en: the art and technique of arranging and printing text

example.en: Good typography makes a book easy to read.
example.zh: 好的排版让一本书易于阅读。

senses.en: metal devices used to open locks (plural of key)

example.en: She left her keys on the kitchen table.
example.zh: 她把钥匙忘在了厨房桌上。

senses.en: buttons pressed on a piano, keyboard, etc.

example.en: Her fingers moved smoothly over the piano keys.
example.zh: 她的手指在钢琴键上流畅地移动。

senses.en: in music, tonal frameworks or scales of a piece

example.en: The song is performed in two different keys.
example.zh: 这首歌以两个不同的调演奏。

senses.en: moving backwards or returning to a worse state

example.en: The country's economy went into retrograde motion after the crisis.
example.zh: 危机过后该国经济开始倒退。

senses.en: to move backwards, especially in decline

example.en: The negotiations retrograded after weeks of progress.
example.zh: 经过数周的进展后，谈判出现了倒退。

senses.en: groups of people who meet regularly for a shared activity, or the buildings/organizations they form

example.en: She joined one of the sports clubs at her university.
example.zh: 她加入了大学里的一个体育俱乐部。

senses.en: (British, in football) sports teams as organizations

example.en: The striker was transferred between two top clubs.
example.zh: 这名前锋在两家顶级俱乐部之间转会。

senses.en: the suit of playing cards marked with black trefoil shapes, or cards of that suit

example.en: He played the ace of clubs.
example.zh: 他打出了梅花A。

senses.en: heavy sticks used as weapons

example.en: The police found wooden clubs at the scene.
example.zh: 警察在现场发现了木棍。

senses.en: the language of Israel and of ancient Jewish texts

example.en: She is learning Hebrew for her studies.
example.zh: 她为了学业正在学习希伯来语。

senses.en: a member of the ancient Hebrew people; a Jew

example.en: The Hebrews settled in Canaan in ancient times.
example.zh: 希伯来人古代定居于迦南。

senses.en: relating to the Hebrew people or their language
senses.zh: 希伯来人的；希伯来语的

example.en: They read a Hebrew text from the Old Testament.
example.zh: 他们阅读了一段《旧约》的希伯来文经文。

senses.en: the front part of a missile or torpedo that carries explosives or other harmful agents

example.en: The missile was equipped with a conventional warhead.
example.zh: 这枚导弹装有常规弹头。

collocations: equip a missile with a warhead

senses.en: a measurement of something in a particular direction, such as length, width, or height
senses.zh: 某一方向上的尺寸（如长、宽或高）

example.en: The room's dimensions are shown on the plan.
example.zh: 房间的尺寸标在平面图上。

senses.en: a part or aspect of a situation or problem

example.en: The report adds a new dimension to the debate.
example.zh: 这份报告为辩论增加了一个新的层面。

senses.en: a direction in which space or a mathematical object extends

example.en: A cube has three dimensions.
example.zh: 立方体有三个维度。

senses.en: a covering worn over the face to hide identity or give protection

example.en: She wore a mask to the party so no one would know who she was.
example.zh: 她戴着面具去参加聚会，这样没人知道她是谁。

senses.en: to hide or disguise a feeling, fact, or intention

example.en: He laughed to mask his nervousness.
example.zh: 他大笑以掩饰紧张。

senses.en: working well without wasting time, money, or effort

example.en: The new engine is more efficient than the old one.
example.zh: 新发动机比旧发动机效率更高。

senses.en: able to do a job well; competent

example.en: She is an efficient manager who solves problems quickly.
example.zh: 她是一位能迅速解决问题的能干经理。

senses.en: a vehicle such as a bus, train, or aircraft that travels regularly back and forth between two places
senses.zh: 往返班车；穿梭交通工具

example.en: The hotel offers a free shuttle to the airport.
example.zh: 酒店提供免费机场班车。

senses.en: to travel or move people regularly back and forth between two places

example.en: Buses shuttle visitors between the parking lot and the museum.
example.zh: 巴士在停车场和博物馆之间往返运送游客。

senses.en: a piece of equipment used in weaving to carry the thread, or the feathered object used in badminton (shuttlecock)

example.en: The weaver's shuttle moved quickly across the loom.
example.zh: 织工的梭子在织机上快速来回移动。

senses.en: a spacecraft that can be used repeatedly to carry people and supplies between Earth and space

example.en: The space shuttle carried astronauts into orbit.
example.zh: 航天飞机将宇航员送入轨道。

senses.en: to take part in an activity or event

example.en: She decided to participate in the community cleanup.
example.zh: 她决定参加社区清洁活动。

senses.en: a person chosen to speak or act for a group

example.en: She was elected as the representative of her class.
example.zh: 她当选为班级代表。

senses.en: typical of a group or class

example.en: This painting is representative of early modern art.
example.zh: 这幅画是早期现代艺术的典型代表。

senses.en: having little physical strength or energy

example.en: After the illness, she felt too weak to walk upstairs.
example.zh: 生病后，她虚弱得走不上楼。

senses.en: not convincing or effective

example.en: The report's conclusion is based on weak evidence.
example.zh: 这份报告的结论建立在缺乏说服力的证据上。

senses.en: containing little alcohol or flavor because of added water; diluted

example.en: This tea is too weak; add another tea bag.
example.zh: 这茶太淡了，再加一个茶包。

senses.en: a container or package holding goods, often sold as a unit
senses.zh: 一包，一盒；包装好的货物

example.en: He bought a pack of pencils at the shop.
example.zh: 他在商店买了一包铅笔。

senses.en: a group of animals, especially wolves or dogs, that live or hunt together

example.en: A pack of wolves crossed the frozen river.
example.zh: 一群狼穿过结冰的河流。

senses.en: to put clothes or other things into a bag or case

example.en: She packed her clothes into a suitcase.
example.zh: 她把衣服装进手提箱。

senses.en: a good level of skill or competence in something, gained through practice

example.en: She passed the exam, which proved her proficiency in English.
example.zh: 她通过了考试，证明了她英语熟练。

senses.en: a country in southeastern Europe, known for its ancient civilization, olives and islands

example.en: Greece attracts millions of tourists every summer.
example.zh: 希腊每年夏天吸引数百万游客。

senses.en: a category or style of art, literature, music, or film

example.en: Science fiction is a popular film genre.
example.zh: 科幻是一种受欢迎的电影类型。

senses.en: behaviour that annoys or troubles someone repeatedly

example.en: She filed a complaint about harassment at work.
example.zh: 她就工作中受到骚扰一事提起了投诉。

senses.en: persistent attacks or criticism intended to pressure someone

example.en: The constant phone calls were a form of harassment.
example.zh: 不断打来的电话是一种骚扰行为。

senses.en: by a large amount; to a great degree

example.en: The price of the house has risen considerably over the past year.
example.zh: 过去一年里房价上涨了不少。

senses.en: making you feel shy, ashamed, or uncomfortable
senses.zh: 令人尴尬的，使人难堪的

example.en: It was embarrassing when I forgot her name.
example.zh: 当我忘了她的名字时，场面很尴尬。

senses.en: continuing for a long time

example.en: The trip left a lasting impression on her.
example.zh: 这次旅行给她留下了持久的印象。

senses.en: arrogant and showing disdain for others

example.en: He gave a haughty answer and refused to listen to anyone.
example.zh: 他傲慢地回答，拒绝听任何人的话。

senses.en: a person whose power comes from wealth; a wealthy and influential person
senses.zh: 财阀；富豪，有钱有势的人

example.en: Critics say the country is increasingly run by plutocrats.
example.zh: 批评人士说，这个国家越来越由财阀掌控。

senses.en: doubting that something is true or useful

example.en: She was sceptical about the plan at first.
example.zh: 起初她对这个计划持怀疑态度。

senses.en: feeling or showing pleasure

example.en: She was happy to see her old friends again.
example.zh: 她很高兴再次见到老朋友。

senses.en: lucky or fortunate

example.en: He chose a happy moment to make the announcement.
example.zh: 他选了一个恰当的时机宣布消息。

senses.en: willing to do something

example.en: We are happy to help with any questions.
example.zh: 我们乐于解答任何问题。

senses.en: feeling regret or sadness about something

example.en: I'm sorry for being late to the meeting.
example.zh: 很抱歉我开会迟到了。

senses.en: used to politely apologize or express sympathy
senses.zh: 对不起的（用于道歉或表示同情）

example.en: Sorry to hear that your grandmother is in hospital.
example.zh: 听说你祖母住院了，我很难过。

senses.en: poor quality; pitiful (informal)

example.en: He made a sorry excuse for missing class.
example.zh: 他为缺课找了个站不住脚的借口。

senses.en: a county in southern England on the English Channel, historically an Anglo-Saxon kingdom
senses.zh: 苏塞克斯（英国南部郡名，历史上曾是盎格鲁-撒克逊王国）

example.en: We spent a weekend walking in the countryside of Sussex.
example.zh: 我们周末在苏塞克斯的乡间散步。

senses.en: a series of extra games played to decide a winner, especially when teams are tied or after a regular season
senses.zh: 加时决胜赛；（赛季后的）季后赛

example.en: The team won the playoff and advanced to the final.
example.zh: 该队赢得了这场决胜赛，晋级决赛。

senses.en: to predict or tell about something before it happens

example.en: No one could have foretold how the story would end.
example.zh: 没有人能预言故事的结局。

senses.en: a device or desk used to connect telephone calls; also a panel controlling electrical circuits

example.en: The operator connected the call through the switchboard.
example.zh: 接线员通过交换机接通了电话。

senses.en: the kick that starts a football game or restarts it after a score

example.en: The kickoff was delayed by heavy rain.
example.zh: 开球因大雨而推迟。

senses.en: the start of an event or activity

example.en: The project kickoff meeting is on Monday.
example.zh: 项目启动会议在周一。

senses.en: to use known facts to estimate something beyond them

example.en: We can extrapolate future sales from this year's figures.
example.zh: 我们可以根据今年的数字推断未来的销售情况。

senses.en: a device that uses sound waves underwater to detect objects and measure distances

example.en: The submarine used sonar to detect other vessels.
example.zh: 潜艇用声呐探测其他船只。

senses.en: a long angry speech of criticism or denunciation
senses.zh: 长篇激烈的抨击性讲话

example.en: He launched into a tirade against the new policy.
example.zh: 他开始对新政策进行长篇激烈的抨击。

senses.en: the earth and all the people, places, and things on it

example.en: The internet connects people around the world.
example.zh: 互联网连接着世界各地的人们。

senses.en: a particular area of activity or group of people

example.en: She is well known in the fashion world.
example.zh: 她在时尚界很有名。

senses.en: a person's experience of life and the people around them
senses.zh: 个人生活圈子；生活经历

example.en: The birth of their child changed their world.
example.zh: 孩子的出生改变了他们的生活。

senses.en: an adult male person

example.en: A man asked for directions at the station.
example.zh: 一名男子在车站问路。

senses.en: human beings considered as a group

example.en: The book explores the history of man.
example.zh: 这本书探讨了人类的历史。

senses.en: to operate a machine or place, or supply people to work it

example.en: She manned the help desk all morning.
example.zh: 她整个上午都守在服务台值班。

senses.en: used to express surprise or strong feeling

example.en: Man, that was close!
example.zh: 天哪，好险！

senses.en: the front part of the neck

example.en: She tied a scarf around her throat.
example.zh: 她在脖子上系了一条围巾。

senses.en: the passage from the mouth down the neck

example.en: The pill stuck in his throat.
example.zh: 药片卡在他的喉咙里。

senses.en: in 'a lump in your throat': a tight feeling caused by strong emotion, often making speech difficult
senses.zh: 用于 a lump in your throat，指强烈情绪引起的喉头发紧或哽咽感

example.en: A lump formed in her throat as she spoke.
example.zh: 她说话时感到喉头哽咽。

senses.en: a vegetable with large green or red leaves that are eaten raw in salads

example.en: She washed the lettuce and added it to the salad.
example.zh: 她洗了生菜，把它加进沙拉里。

senses.en: the plant that produces these leaves

example.en: We grow lettuce in the garden every spring.
example.zh: 我们每年春天在菜园里种生菜。

senses.en: the part of a plant that usually grows underground and takes in water

example.en: The tree's roots spread under the sidewalk.
example.zh: 这棵树的根在人行道下蔓延。

senses.en: the basic cause or origin of something

example.en: We need to find the root of the problem.
example.zh: 我们需要找到问题的根源。

senses.en: to support or cheer for a team or person

example.en: The whole neighborhood rooted for the underdog.
example.zh: 整个街区都为弱队加油。

senses.en: a number that produces a specified number when multiplied by itself one or more times

example.en: Four is the square root of sixteen.
example.zh: 四是十六的平方根。

senses.en: a road vehicle with two wheels and an engine

example.en: She rode her motorcycle along the coast.
example.zh: 她骑着摩托车沿着海岸行驶。

senses.en: a doctor who performs medical operations

example.en: The surgeon performed the operation in under two hours.
example.zh: 这位外科医生在不到两小时内完成了手术。

senses.en: a large desert animal with one or two humps on its back

example.en: The camel can travel long distances across the desert without drinking water.
example.zh: 骆驼可以在沙漠中长途跋涉而不喝水。

senses.en: a look back at past events

example.en: In retrospect, the decision was a mistake.
example.zh: 回想起来，那个决定是个错误。

senses.en: the direction midway between north and east

example.en: The village lies to the northeast of the city.
example.zh: 那个村庄位于城市的东北方向。

senses.en: in, toward, or coming from the northeast
senses.zh: 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的

example.en: A cold northeast wind was blowing all day.
example.zh: 寒冷的东北风刮了一整天。

senses.en: toward or in the northeast

example.en: The plane flew northeast for two hours.
example.zh: 飞机向东北飞行了两个小时。

senses.en: a very stupid person (an offensive insult)

example.en: Only an idiot would leave the door unlocked in that neighborhood.
example.zh: 只有白痴才会在那个街区不锁门。

senses.en: a foolish or silly person (informal, milder)
senses.zh: 傻瓜；（尤指做了蠢事的）笨蛋

example.en: I felt like an idiot after forgetting her name again.
example.zh: 我又忘了她的名字，觉得自己像个笨蛋。

senses.en: (medicine, dated) a person with severe intellectual disability

example.en: The word idiot is no longer used in medical diagnosis.
example.zh: 白痴一词已不再用于医学诊断。

senses.en: the traditional stories, songs and customs of a people

example.en: Dragons appear in the folklore of many countries.
example.zh: 龙出现在许多国家的民间传说中。

senses.en: the act or process of using up a resource or supply

example.en: Overfishing has led to the depletion of fish stocks.
example.zh: 过度捕捞导致鱼类资源枯竭。

senses.en: failure to take proper care

example.en: The accident was caused by negligence on the part of the driver.
example.zh: 事故是由司机的疏忽造成的。

senses.en: the science and practice of growing fruits, vegetables, flowers, and other plants

example.en: She studied horticulture at the agricultural college.
example.zh: 她在农业学院学习园艺。

senses.en: a person who patrols an area to keep watch or maintain order

example.en: A ski patroller checked the slopes every morning.
example.zh: 一名滑雪巡逻员每天早上检查雪道。

senses.en: something that brings sudden good fortune, especially a chance to make money
senses.zh: 带来好运的事；财源；富矿脉

example.en: The new highway turned the small town into a business bonanza.
example.zh: 新公路给这座小镇带来了商业上的巨大机遇。

senses.en: present in a person from birth

example.en: The baby was born with a congenital heart defect.
example.zh: 这名婴儿出生时患有先天性心脏缺陷。

senses.en: (of a trait) natural and long-standing

example.en: He has a congenital inability to admit mistakes.
example.zh: 他天生就不肯承认错误。

senses.en: a long song for one voice in an opera

example.en: The soprano performed a beautiful aria from the opera.
example.zh: 女高音演唱了歌剧中一段优美的咏叹调。

senses.en: to make someone feel very happy and excited

example.en: The mountain air exhilarated the travelers.
example.zh: 山间清新的空气令旅行者心旷神怡。

senses.en: long narrow bands of color on a surface

example.en: The flag has red and white stripes.
example.zh: 这面旗子有红白条纹。

senses.en: V-shaped badges on a uniform showing military rank

example.en: He earned his sergeant's stripes after five years.
example.zh: 五年后他获得了中士军衔臂章。

senses.en: investigations or research projects on a subject (plural of study)

example.en: Recent studies show that exercise improves sleep.
example.zh: 近期研究表明锻炼能改善睡眠。

senses.en: learning and schoolwork (plural of study)

example.en: She continued her studies at a university in London.
example.zh: 她在伦敦的一所大学继续学业。
